items.title: Aankho me basi thi karbobala sajjad tadapte rehte
items.body:
Aankho me basi thi karbobala sajjad tadapte rehte the
Shabbir ka gham tadpaata tha sajjad tadapte rehte the
<<DIVIDER>>
naize ki ani par baap ka sar wo shaame ghareeba'n ka manzar
har waqt nazar ke saamne tha sajjad tadapte rehte the
<<DIVIDER>>
gardan me pada tha touqe giraa'n , thi paau me zanjeere'n har aa'n
mushkil tha khada hona seedha sajjad tadapte rehte the
<<DIVIDER>>
the paao ke chaale qaak basar chil jaate the talwe reh reh kar
kaanto pe chalaate the aada sajjad tadapte rehte the
<<DIVIDER>>
sooraj ki tapish se waawaila jab dhoop me tapta tha loha
jab jism mubaarak jalta tha sajjad tadapte rehte the
<<DIVIDER>>
maa behno ko apni be parda baazar me jab se tha dekha
jab se thi chini zainab ki rida sajjad tadapte rehte the
<<DIVIDER>>
jab poochta tha koi aakar thi saqt musibat kis jaa'n par
ash'shaam kaha karte the sada sajjad tadapte rehte the

items.title: Aey raat zaraa aahista guzar
items.body:
Aey raat zaraa aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ashoor ki shab Zainab ney kahaa,
Aey raat zaraa aahista guzar
Ehsaan tera mujh par hogaa,
Aey raat zaraa aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Lutjaaeingay kal khaimey saarey,
Jal jaayegi masnad Ahmed ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Hojaayega kal khaali jhoola,
Aey raat zaraa aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Suljhaaney baetthi hai Laila
Akber ki bikhri zulfoun ko
Maloom nahin kal kya hogaa,
Aey raat zaraa aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kal pyaasey baraati aayeingay
Kal Qasim ki shaadi hoveygi
Hojaayegi kal Kubra beywaa,
Aey raat zaraa aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas-e-Alambardaar bhi
Talwaar pa saiqal kartay hain
Kal inko hai johar dikhlaana,
Aey raat zaraa aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek baar apney bharay ghar ko
Jee bharkay dekh toh ley Zainab
Kal hojaayega sannaata,
Aey raat zaraa aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jee bhar kay dekh toh ley aye Zainab
Aaj apney bhaayi ki soorath
Katt jaayega kal Sarwar ka gala
Aey raat zaraa aahista guzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis yaas sey aur kis hasrat sey
Zainab yeh bayaan karti thi Sayeed
Aahista guzar aey raat zaraa,
Aey raat zaraa aahista guzar
